site.tagline: Tell it what to do. Your files stay on your device.
site.supportingMessage: Local-first document automation for PDF and Word files.
site.secondaryMessage: Process, organize, merge, convert and manage documents locally in your browser.
site.description: LocalDocu is a privacy-first, local-first document tool. Merge, split, compress, rotate, and convert PDF and Word files in your browser — document contents stay on your device.
site.shortDescription: Privacy-first local PDF and Word automation. Files stay on your device.

noscript: The interactive workspace needs JavaScript. Everything on this page is readable without it; enable JavaScript to merge, split, compress or convert files locally.

trust.offlineBannerBody: Local document tools continue to work on this page. Avoid refreshing — it can clear documents in this session. Prefer a normal reload over hard refresh (Shift+Reload): hard refresh bypasses the service worker and usually fails while offline.
trust.detailsOnlineBody: Network available. Local document processing still happens on this device.
trust.detailsOfflineBody: Offline. Local document tools continue to work. Going offline does not stop an in-progress local operation — refreshing or closing the tab can. Soft reload uses the cached app shell; hard refresh usually cannot while offline.
trust.contentsProcessedLocally: Document contents are processed on this device.
trust.localDocuAiOffDetail: LocalDocu AI: Off (desktop, metadata-only intent — not in this web release)
trust.notUploadedFootnote: Files are not uploaded for document processing. Processed locally on your device.

notFound.body: That address is not a LocalDocu page.
notFound.bodyFull: That address is not a LocalDocu page. Open the workspace or one of the pages below.

tasks.heading: Every tool you need, running on your device
tasks.subheading: Pick a task to get started. Files are processed locally and never uploaded.
tasks.workspaceLink: Prefer one place for everything? Use the full workspace below.
tasks.allPdfToolsLink: All PDF tools in one page

mergePdf.title: Merge PDF
mergePdf.desc: Combine multiple PDFs into one file in the order you choose.

splitPdf.title: Split PDF
splitPdf.desc: Separate every page of a PDF into its own file.

compressPdf.title: Compress PDF
compressPdf.desc: Shrink PDF file size while keeping the quality you need.

docxToPdf.title: Word to PDF
docxToPdf.desc: Convert DOC and DOCX documents into readable PDFs.

extractPages.title: Extract pages
extractPages.desc: Pull selected pages out of a PDF into a new document.

deletePages.title: Delete pages
deletePages.desc: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF in a few clicks.

rotatePdf.title: Rotate PDF
rotatePdf.desc: Turn pages to the right orientation and save the result.

reorderPages.title: Reorder pages
reorderPages.desc: Rearrange PDF pages into exactly the order you want.

mergeDocx.title: Merge Word
mergeDocx.desc: Join several Word documents into a single DOCX file.

chatPdf.title: Chat with PDF
chatPdf.desc: Ask questions about your documents with on-device AI.

summarize.title: Summarize
summarize.desc: Get short summaries of long documents, processed locally.

ocr.title: OCR
ocr.desc: Turn scanned pages into searchable, selectable text.
